from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im = Image.open('mol_0129.png').convert('L')
a = np.array(im) < 128
def dark_frac(p,q,n=80,rad=2):
    xs = np.linspace(p[0],q[0],n); ys = np.linspace(p[1],q[1],n)
    cnt=0
    for x,y in zip(xs,ys):
        x=int(round(x)); y=int(round(y))
        win = a[max(0,y-rad):y+rad+1, max(0,x-rad):x+rad+1]
        if win.any(): cnt+=1
    return cnt/n
V = {
 'A':(220,235),'B':(160,155),'C':(270,125),'D':(395,150),'E':(455,262),'F':(340,238),
 'Oeth':(372,320),'C6':(585,262),'C5':(605,150),'C7':(705,145),'C8':(690,262),
